cards.gloss_en: It is fun to surf there and, e.g., watch funny videos or chat with friends.
cards.sentence_de: Es macht Spaß, dort zu surfen und z.B. lustige Videos anzusehen oder mit Freunden zu chatten.

cards.gloss_en: The ball flew narrowly past the far post.
cards.sentence_de: Der Ball flog knapp am langen Pfosten vorbei.

cards.gloss_en: Without a chance, the rivals flew past him.
cards.sentence_de: Chancenlos flogen die Rivalen an ihm vorbei.

cards.gloss_en: The left-footed shot flies past the left of the goal.
cards.sentence_de: Der Linksschuss fliegt links am Tor vorbei.

cards.gloss_en: A stork flies past a power line.
cards.sentence_de: Ein Storch fliegt an einer Stromleitung vorbei.

cards.gloss_en: An asteroid flew past Earth.
cards.sentence_de: Ein Asteroid flog an der Erde vorbei.

cards.gloss_en: The ball flies past the basket.
cards.sentence_de: Der Ball fliegt am Korb vorbei.
